## [3.12.0](https://github.com/xboyrex/rex-ig-lite/releases/tag/v3.12.0) (2026-11-01)

### ✨ New Features

* **xboyrex:** Full unified Instagram & X patch suite with Android classes.dex bundle support, 60+ custom vector outline icons, Quick Action Menu, Secret Blocked Profile viewer, and support for Instagram 453.0.0.57.79, 451.0.0.53.80, and 447.0.0.55.81.
